title: The Lovely Effects of Alcohol
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 14, 2023, police responded to a welfare check at a bar in West Salem, WI. They found a heavily intoxicated man who had collapsed repeatedly. Recognizing him from previous encounters, where he displayed violent behavior while intoxicated, the officers decided to transport him to the hospital for detox. However, at the hospital, his behavior escalated and he became increasingly resistant.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
